newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Prapatan sees '96 net up on restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Prapatan sees '96 net up on restaurants.

text.p: Indonesian hotel operator PT Hotel Prapatan said on Friday it expected a sharp increase in 1996 net profit after launching new restaurants during the year.

Hotel Prapatan briefly gained 125 rupiah to touch a high of 2,575 rupiah minutes after the Jakarta stock market opening, but profit-taking erased the gains to 25 rupiah in late trading. At 2,575 rupiah, it was up 47.14 percent from a closing price of 1,750 rupiah last Friday.

"We expect the 1996 net profit to be much better compared with 1995 net. We expect it to be at around 11 billion rupiah against only around two billion rupiah in 1995," corporate secretary Dodi Hermawan told Reuters.

Hermawan said the hotel launched three new restaurants in the major cities of Jakarta, Bandung and Surabaya in 1996. He said the company's success in collecting previously non performing accounts receivables also contributed to the rise in net profit.
Hermawan did not give further details.
Prapatan posted a net profit of 2.08 billion rupiah in 1995 against 6.8 billion rupiah in 1994.
